feature.bm_mode.description: The easy mode of the wiki: fewer features and simpler screens, adjustable item by item.
feature.bm_mode.name: BM mode
bm_mode.title: BM mode
bm_mode.intro: BM mode is the easy mode of this wiki: it hides the features a first wiki rarely needs and simplifies the screens that remain. Nothing is deleted: whatever you hide comes back as it was when you show it again.
bm_mode.switch: Use BM mode for the whole wiki
bm_mode.switch_hint: On: everyone is in BM mode. Off: the full wiki, with every feature its own switch allows, and each account can still be in BM mode on its own (below).
bm_mode.operator_default: The server starts this wiki in BM mode (on the hosting platform: easy mode). What you choose here applies until that setting changes again.
bm_mode.features_hint: Ticked features are available in BM mode; the others are hidden there. A feature that is available still follows its own switch under Plugins.
bm_mode.simplifications_hint: Each one hides controls that are rarely needed. The pages behind them stay available and nobody loses a permission.
bm_mode.no_simplifications: No feature in use has anything to simplify.
bm_mode.flash.everyone_on: {count} accounts were put in BM mode.
bm_mode.flash.everyone_on_one: 1 account was put in BM mode.
bm_mode.flash.everyone_off: {count} accounts were taken out of BM mode.
bm_mode.flash.everyone_off_one: 1 account was taken out of BM mode.
bm_mode.flash.own_on: BM mode is on for your account.
bm_mode.flash.own_off: BM mode is off for your account.
bm_mode.simplify.getting_started_hint: Shows administrators the first steps on the dashboard until they are done.
bm_mode.start.title: Getting started
bm_mode.start.hint: A few first steps for your wiki. This list disappears once they are done.
bm_mode.start.invite: Invite people with an invite code
bm_mode.start.name: Give the wiki its name
bm_mode.people.title: BM mode for single accounts
bm_mode.people.hint: While BM mode is off for the whole wiki, an account can be in BM mode on its own: that person gets the same simpler screens, and the features hidden in BM mode leave their menus and pages. The features keep working for everyone else, and their checks still apply to that person. Administrators switch accounts on their page under Users.
bm_mode.people.self_service: Everyone may switch BM mode on or off for their own account
bm_mode.people.self_service_hint: Under Customise. On an account's page you can allow or forbid it for that account alone, whatever this says.
bm_mode.people.new_accounts: New accounts start in BM mode
bm_mode.people.new_accounts_hint: Accounts created from now on, by sign-up, invite or an administrator.
bm_mode.people.count: {count} accounts are in BM mode on their own.
bm_mode.people.count_one: 1 account is in BM mode on its own.
bm_mode.everyone.title: Accounts by role
bm_mode.everyone.hint: Puts the accounts with the ticked roles that you may manage in BM mode, or takes them all out. An account with a custom role counts under its base role. Whether people may switch it themselves stays as it is.
bm_mode.everyone.off: Take them out of BM mode
bm_mode.everyone.on_confirm: Put every account with the ticked roles that you may manage in BM mode?
bm_mode.everyone.off_confirm: Take every account with the ticked roles that you may manage out of BM mode?
bm_mode.everyone.role.admin_hint: Just your own account: only an owner or a superuser can change another administrator.
bm_mode.everyone.role.admin_top_hint: Other administrators and your own account. Other owners and superusers stay as they are.
bm_mode.own.title: BM mode
bm_mode.own.hint: BM mode is the easy mode: simpler screens and fewer features to find your way through.
bm_mode.own.wiki_on: This wiki uses BM mode for everyone.
bm_mode.own.on_by_admin: BM mode is on for your account. Your administrators decide when it changes.
bm_mode.own.off_by_admin: BM mode is off for your account. Your administrators decide when it changes.
bm_mode.user.title: BM mode
bm_mode.user.wiki_on: BM mode is on for the whole wiki, so it applies to this account whatever is chosen here.
bm_mode.user.switch_hint: Simpler screens, and the features hidden in BM mode leave their menus and pages.
bm_mode.user.rule: May switch it on their own
bm_mode.user.state_on: This account is in BM mode.
bm_mode.user.state_off: This account is not in BM mode.
